verses.text_en: And then Michael, Uriel, Raphael, and Gabriel looked down from heaven and saw much blood being shed upon the earth, and all lawlessness being wrought upon the earth.
verses.text_hr: Tada Mihael, Uriel, Rafael i Gabriel pogledaše s neba i vidješe mnogo krvi prolivene po zemlji i sve bezakonje koje se na njoj činilo.

verses.text_en: And they said one to another: ‘The earth, made †without inhabitant, cries the voice of their crying† up to the gates of heaven.
verses.text_hr: Rekoše jedan drugomu: ‘Opustošena zemlja †glasom njihovih vapaja viče† sve do vrata nebeskih.

verses.text_en: 〚And now to you, the holy ones of heaven〛, the souls of men make their suit, saying, “Bring our cause before the Most High”.’
verses.text_hr: 〚A sada vama, sveti nebeski,〛 duše se ljudi tuže govoreći: „Iznesite našu parnicu pred Svevišnjega.”’

verses.text_en: And they said to the Lord =of the ages=: ‘Lord of lords, God of gods, King of kings ‹and God of the ages›, the throne of Thy glory (standeth) unto all the generations of the ages, and Thy name holy and glorious and blessed unto all the ages!
verses.text_hr: I rekoše Gospodinu =vjekova=: ‘Gospodaru gospodara, Bože bogova, Kralju kraljeva ‹i Bože vjekova›, prijestolje Tvoje slave stoji kroz sve naraštaje vjekova, a Tvoje je ime sveto, slavno i blagoslovljeno u sve vjekove!

verses.text_en: Thou hast made all things, and power over all things hast Thou: and all things are naked and open in Thy sight, and all things Thou seest, and nothing can hide itself from Thee.
verses.text_hr: Ti si sve stvorio i nad svime imaš vlast; sve je pred Tobom golo i otkriveno, sve vidiš i ništa se od Tebe ne može skriti.

verses.text_en: Thou seest what Azâzêl hath done, who hath taught all unrighteousness on earth and revealed the eternal secrets which were (preserved) in heaven, which men were striving to =learn=:
verses.text_hr: Vidiš što je učinio Azazel, koji je podučio svemu bezakonju na zemlji i otkrio vječne tajne čuvane na nebu, koje su ljudi nastojali =naučiti=.

verses.text_en: And Semjâzâ, to whom Thou hast given authority to bear rule over his associates.
verses.text_hr: I Semjaza, kojemu si dao vlast da vlada nad svojim drugovima.

verses.text_en: And they have gone to the daughters of men upon the earth, and have slept with the women, and have defiled themselves, and revealed to them all kinds of sins.
verses.text_hr: Otišli su kćerima ljudskim na zemlji, legli sa ženama, okaljali se i otkrili im svakojake grijehe.

verses.text_en: And the women have borne giants, and the whole earth has thereby been filled with blood and unrighteousness.
verses.text_hr: Žene su rodile divove te se sva zemlja zbog toga napunila krvlju i bezakonjem.

verses.text_en: And now, behold, the souls of those who have died are crying and making their suit to the gates of heaven, and their lamentations have ascended: and cannot =cease= because of the lawless deeds which are wrought on the earth.
verses.text_hr: A sada, gle, duše umrlih vape i tuže se pred vratima nebeskim; njihovi su se jecaji uzdigli i ne mogu =prestati= zbog bezakonih djela koja se čine na zemlji.

verses.text_en: And Thou knowest all things before they come to pass, and Thou seest these things and Thou dost suffer them, and Thou dost not say to us what we are to do to them in regard to these.’
verses.text_hr: Ti poznaješ sve prije nego što se dogodi; vidiš to i dopuštaš im, a ne govoriš nam što da im učinimo zbog svega ovoga.’
